name: Lorgalis Manuscript
summary: Beneath Ashenvale, the Lorgalis Manuscript lies in the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. The ancient text speaks of the Old Gods, and dark scholars covet its words about sleeping powers.

sections.title: A Tome of Those Who Sleep
sections.body:
The Lorgalis Manuscript lies at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps, among the ruins where long-dead elves once lived. Lorgalis wrote of the Old Gods, who raged across Azeroth when the world was new and now lie chained in sleep. The text praises Aku'mai, servant of the Old Gods, who dwells in the Deeps.

Its lore is said to open mystical doorways and stir ancient beings sleeping deep beneath the world. The manuscript rests in a pitted iron chest among the flooded corridors. Cultists and shadow scholars alike seek its words.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: In Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern, the eccentric collector Gerrig Bonegrip hires adventurers to cross the sea and retrieve the manuscript. Bonegrip speaks with reverence of the end days and the awakening of sleeping deities. He means to have the text copied and shared among his shadowy circle of brothers and sisters, spreading forbidden knowledge that surface folk were never meant to understand.

faq.answer: The Lorgalis Manuscript is an old text written by Lorgalis about the Old Gods. Its contents are said to reveal how to open doorways and awaken slumbering primordial beings.
The manuscript rests in a pitted iron chest deep within Blackfathom Deeps, a ruined night elven temple along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale.
Gerrig Bonegrip works from the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge and wants the manuscript recovered. He plans to copy it and share its teachings with his secretive peers.

faq.q: Why does Gerrig Bonegrip talk about the end days?
faq.answer: Bonegrip reveres and studies the Old Gods. He seeks ancient elven writings about awakening Those Who Sleep, which he believes heralds the coming end times.

angles.text: As a Warlock, you find a rare glimpse of forbidden lore about the Old Gods and the entities of the deep, knowledge coveted by those who practice dark arts.
As a night elf, you find the text in drowned ruins where your people once lived. Its reverence for Aku'mai and the Old Gods reveals the dark worship rooted in those fallen halls.
